ownership.summary: WORX is a brand of privately held Positec Group. Reviewed trademark records name Positec Group Limited as owner for WORX rights in the relevant jurisdiction, and Positec describes WORX and Kress as group brands. A 2025 equity financing introduced institutional investors but did not publish a current shareholder-percentage table. Founder Don Gao remains the group's CEO.

leadership.name: Don Gao
leadership.role: Founder and CEO of Positec Group
leadership.context: Positec's January 2025 financing announcement identifies Don Gao as founder and CEO.

productPortfolio.name: Landroid Vision AI
productPortfolio.positioning: Camera- and AI-led robotic mowers target wire-free installation with model-dependent lawn capacity and features.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Requires checks for terrain, edge handling, object recognition, lighting, app support and regional availability.

productPortfolio.name: Landroid Vision Cloud
productPortfolio.positioning: Connected mower variants extend mapping and cloud-supported functions beyond the classic boundary-wire proposition.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Cloud dependence adds account, data, subscription, firmware and service-continuity considerations.

productPortfolio.name: Classic Landroid
productPortfolio.positioning: Established boundary-wire mower families cover multiple residential lawn sizes through mainstream retail channels.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Creates a mature installed base, but model generations, accessories and warranty rules need exact-SKU matching.

productPortfolio.name: WORX power and garden tools
productPortfolio.positioning: Cordless tools, batteries and outdoor power equipment give Landroid access to a broader home-improvement ecosystem.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Shared brand and dealer access do not prove battery, service or legal-manufacturer compatibility across product categories.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Positec identifies manufacturing bases in Suzhou, Zhangjiagang and Kunshan in China and in Vietnam.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Verify the physical factory and origin for the exact mower, charger, battery and accessory.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: A reviewed UK product-security statement names Positec Technology (China) Co., Ltd. as manufacturer for a listed set of Landroid models.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match the model number and regulatory statement before relying on the Suzhou manufacturer record.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Positec reports R&D centers in Italy, Suzhou and Shanghai and manufacturing across four bases.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Separate design center, legal manufacturer, assembly plant and component supplier in due-diligence records.

marketsChannels.evidence: Positec says its products reach around 70 countries through WORX, Kress and other group brands.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm current WORX mower availability, dealer authorization and service maturity in the target country.

marketsChannels.evidence: U.S. terms identify Positec Tool Corporation and related companies, while UK materials identify Positec (UK & Ireland) Limited for selected regional roles.
marketsChannels.scope: Regional selling, website and warranty entities
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Record the invoice seller, importer, warranty party and payment beneficiary rather than contracting with a brand name.

marketsChannels.evidence: European connected-product information can identify Positec Germany GmbH as a data holder while another Positec company operates the app or sells the mower.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Verify app region, data rights, firmware support, account transfer and service continuity.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: WORX gives Positec a recognizable retail brand, broad power-tool distribution and a long-running Landroid mower franchise. New vision and cloud variants modernize that installed base. Its main buyer-side challenge is responsibility mapping across the brand owner, model manufacturer, four production bases and regional companies that handle commerce, warranty and connected data.
